title: WCD UP Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 146 Anganwadi Worker Posts
description: The Uttar Pradesh Women and Child Development (WCD UP) has announced the official notification for 2026. To fill the vacancies for 146 Anganwadi Worker Jobs. Candidates with 12th pass can apply for the WCD UP Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply online by the application deadline. The application process has already started...
